name: delay
description: Delay long-running jobs, such as slow autotest suites, to the user's run window on a Mac: Claude queues an approved job by name only and reminds the user to start the runner; the user's sudo start.sh schedules a pmset wake and loads the runner, which runs the jobs in each project's own docker container with the screen locked, keeps the results, and unloads itself (no always-on daemon). Jobs, their sha256-pinned confinement and the window are set by a human with sudo. Runtime-free (bash + awk); macOS + launchd.
